Outlook India, 2026 - Anoushka Shankar On Not Attending Grammys 2026
caption:
She took up the sitar at age 8. By 2026, she'd been nominated for a Grammy 13 times.

Anoushka Shankar earned her 12th and 13th Grammy nominations at the 2026 ceremony, for Best Global Music Album ('Chapter III: We Return to Light') and Best Global Music Performance ('Daybreak'). Born in London to sitar legend Ravi Shankar, she performed alongside her father as a teenager until his death in 2012. She was the first Indian woman ever nominated for a Grammy and the first to perform live or present at the ceremony.

Thirteen nominations, zero wins so far - the instrument her father made famous, still finding new rooms to fill.
